name: Quality Concepts Manufacturing Inc
old_description: QCMI understands that partnering with a contract manufacturing company that you can depend on is essential to your business success. In choosing QCMI, you can be confident that your products will be produced with continual high quality, reliability, and on-time delivery.
about:
Quality Concepts Manufacturing Inc (QCMI) operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available materials. The business presents itself as a contract manufacturing partner focused on dependability.

QCMI provides contract manufacturing services spanning turnkey and consigned material programs, documentation creation and verification, printed circuit board assembly, enclosure and cable design, mechanical assembly and box build, electrical testing, direct shipment to end users, and third‑party warranty repair. The firm does not publish facility size, headcount, or production volume figures.

The company does not specify the industries or customer types it serves in its public materials. Its service list suggests a focus on electronics and electromechanical assembly, but no concrete sectors or example clients are cited.

QCMI states that its differentiator lies in its workforce: 'our strength is our people,' emphasizing staff devotion to delivering continual high quality, reliability, and on‑time delivery. The company also highlights turnkey and consigned material flexibility, direct end‑user shipping, and warranty repair capabilities as part of its value proposition.
